tool.title: Skill instruction reference
tool.description: Render the skill instruction bodies — the prose an agent actually loads — as browsable pages with an index, so a reader can see what an agent is told without cloning the repository.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Compare against the committed pages and fail if stale, instead of writing.

outputs.name: skillInstructions
outputs.description: The generated instruction directory. Never hand-edited.

$comment.comment:
Sibling of `schema-docs`, not an alternative to it: one renders a
skill's CONTRACT and the other its INSTRUCTIONS, and a reader wanting
either is not served by the other. Complementary: the output ports
are named for what each writes, so `deriveAlternatives` does not pair
them on a shared skill (#1168, B9a).
